preconditions.description: The number of strings n must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 100 for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each string must have a length between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(s.islower() and s.isalpha() for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each string must consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (stdout.startswith('YES') and all(strings[i] in strings[i+1] for i in range(n-1)))
postconditions.description: If output is 'YES', then each string must be a substring of the next string in the output.
If output is 'YES', the output must contain exactly n strings after the 'YES' line.
